name: Hyphal Extension
effect: Grow 2 steps: toward all food sources in range.
flavor: Apical tips elongate by turgor pressure, fanning out to colonise every nearby crumb of litter.
notes: GLOBAL targeting (no tap). The backbone of the starting deck (run 4-6 copies). Maps to actions.grow; play is FREE (you paid drawCostEnergy to draw it). The OMNIDIRECTIONAL forage member of the grow trio: spreads to all sensed attractors — now advances TWO food-seek passes per play (config cards.foodSeekSteps) so it stays worth a card vs the aimed grows. Pairs against Apical Drive (player-aimed single line) and Foraging Fan (player-aimed fan). No goal-pathing (R8) — it follows sensed attractors, not the goal. familyKey:basics.

name: Leaf Litter Cache
effect: Pick a direction; drop a SMALL nutrient patch at the edge of sensing range.
flavor: Saprotrophs pre-position on a thin scatter of decaying leaf litter, seeding the next colonisation front.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=small (R3: patch dropped at sensing-range EDGE in chosen direction, player picks direction NOT distance). Smallest member of the substrate size family (small->medium->large). Maps to actions.addSubstrate, play FREE. Strong EARLY for routing a Grow where you want; near-dud LATE (no time to grow into it). Not auto-include: wasted if no follow-up Grow is queued. familyKey:basics.

name: Acorn Cache
effect: Pick a direction; drop a small (2⚡) nut cache at the edge of sensing range.
flavor: The colony buries a small hoard of acorns and chestnuts — a slow-burning meal for the advancing front.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=small. Player-placed lower-tier food: gives ENERGY on digestion only, never a card draft (only map leaf-litter piles draft). Nut reskin that REPLACES Leaf Litter Cache in the starter/tutorial decks. familyKey:basics.

name: Apical Drive
effect: Grow 3 steps: choose a direction.
flavor: Hyphae lock onto a single advance heading, ramming the front across open ground in one committed line.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; grows config cards.directionalSteps (now 9 = 3 steps) along the player-aimed vector. Replaces the CUT Chemotropic Probe but is player-AIMED (R8) — the player picks the direction, NOT 'toward the goal' and NOT obstacle-pathing. Genuine straight-vs-branch tradeoff with Hyphal Extension: committing to a heading skips off-axis side piles, so neither dominates. Best EARLY for crossing a known open gap. Buffed 2->3 steps (with Leading Cord, which shares directionalSteps) so the free grows stay viable next to the paid grow family. familyKey:basics.

name: Foraging Fan
effect: Grow 3 steps: choose a direction and fan out.
flavor: The colony throws a fan of probing tips one way — a slow wedge of hyphae opening into open ground.
notes: AIMED directional FAN (press-and-drag, like the other grow cards): fans a wedge of probe-chains fanSteps (9 seg = 3 steps) deep in the chosen direction — engine method growFanDirected (config cards.fanSteps/fanRays/fanSpread). Reads like the old omni fan played 3x but committed to ONE direction. Attractor-free (needs no sensed food), so it still works on a barren stretch where Hyphal Extension stalls. familyKey:basics.

name: Tropic Lunge
effect: Grow 5 steps toward the nearest food source, even if out of range.
flavor: Starved tips strain past their normal sensing horizon, lunging for the faintest trace of nutrient.
notes: FIXED per reviewer (high): removed the self-contradictory fallback ('no attractor sensed, yet grow toward nearest attractor within range'); the card is now UNPLAYABLE when no attractor is sensed (R7 — no do-nothing branch). DIRECTIONAL-to-attractor growth trick (R3b: 'grow 3 toward the nearest sensed substrate even if out of range'); growthAmount=3 toward nearest attractor. Targets the attractor, not the goal (R8). Distinct from Apical Drive (player-aimed) and Hyphal Extension (forage all): this one over-reaches to a single nearest attractor. Not auto-include: greyed out on open ground with no attractor, so you must have a patch/pile in or just past range to fire it. familyKey:basics.

name: Humus Bed
effect: Pick a direction; drop a MEDIUM patch at the edge of sensing range.
flavor: A built-up bed of rotted humus offers a fat, slow-burning meal for the advancing front.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=medium (R3: sensing-range edge in chosen direction, direction only). The MIDDLE member of the substrate size family, sitting between Leaf Litter Cache (small) and Humic Mat (large). A bigger attractor and a bigger later Digest yield than the small patch, but no reach difference — pure size differentiation per R3. Not auto-include: same routing-dependence as the small patch, just a heavier commit. familyKey:basics.

name: Humic Mat
effect: Pick a direction; drop a LARGE patch at the edge of sensing range.
flavor: A symbiotic mat of mycelium and rootlets lays down a broad, nutrient-dense colonisation target.
notes: DIRECTIONAL targeting; patchSize=large (R3: sensing-range edge in chosen direction, direction only). LARGEST member of the substrate size family. Biggest attractor pull and the richest later Digest reservoir, but identical placement rule to the smaller patches (size is the only lever, R3). Best MID when you want to firmly redirect the front or bank fuel for Digest. Not auto-include: overkill for a quick reroute where the small/medium patch suffices, and wasted LATE. familyKey:basics.

name: Saprotrophic Digest
effect: Drain 1 nutrient from every occupied food source, doubling the energy received.
flavor: Secreted cellulases and ligninases break litter into absorbable sugars across the whole colonised mat.
notes: FIXED per reviewer (low): refund realigned to the locked digest base=1 model (R5). Digest base rate = 1 flat nutrient per occupied patch (replaces the old drainFraction 0.5); refund is +1 energy per occupied patch drained — flat, no percentages, scales only with how much substrate you've colonised. GLOBAL targeting (R4: hits ALL occupied substrate, never a specific cell). One-shot energy, NOT an engine (no per-round produce, repayRounds 0) so it cannot break the idle/clock invariant. On a small network (1-5 patches) the refund stays below drawCost 8, so spamming it to draw is net-negative — it only pays off when you have broad substrate you were going to abandon. Relief valve when energy is tight; a waste when you'd rather keep the substrate as a live attractor. familyKey:basics.

name: Appressorial Punch
effect: Grow through one in-range rock.
flavor: A melanin-walled appressorium builds enormous turgor to drive a penetration peg through the rock — up to ~8 MPa, as in Magnaporthe.
notes: DIRECTIONAL single-rock target: clears the nearest in-range ROCK feature and threads a strand through it. Works on ANY solid rock — loose boulders, big formations and path-blocking columns all read the same to players, so they clear the same way (lakes/water excluded). Clears the whole connected feature (capped). NO weak-Grow fallback — if no rock is in range the card is UNPLAYABLE (R6: no do-nothing). Free floor basic, not resource-gated (keeps the basic floor playable when resource-dry). familyKey:basics.

name: Sclerotial Crust
effect: Tap a point: strands nearby harden — immune to infection and eating for 10 rounds.
flavor: Hyphae aggregate into a hard, melanin-blackened sclerotial rind that pathogens cannot breach.
notes: RADIUS-AROUND-A-TAP targeting; radius=40 (small member of the protect/heal radius family, copying the Amputate radius-60 primitive). Replaces the CUT Septal Plug, which was single-node (R7 — illegal on phone); same reactive-defense identity, now radius-based (R7/R9). Dead card if no threat is near the tapped pocket (NOT auto-include); valuable when a mould cloud or nematode swarm is about to chew your only route. 2-round window forces timing — play too early and immunity lapses before the threat arrives. Free floor basic, ungated. familyKey:basics.

name: Hyphal Osmosis
effect: If your network touches a lake edge, harvest +9 Water. Otherwise gain +3 Water from soil.
flavor: Hyphae draw free water across their walls by simple osmotic imbibition; even dry soil yields a trickle of condensation.
notes: Floor water source, free deck-floor basic (buyCostEnergy 0, R2). GLOBAL targeting: checks whole-network lake adjacency, no tap. Never a full dud (inv. 6/7): +2 lakeside, +1 off-lake, but lakeside double yield keeps routing the point. Below the +3 lake-action so installs stay worth it. Payload of Capillary Runners. You still paid drawCostEnergy 8 to draw it.

name: Phosphate Tap
effect: If your network contacts any mineral, crystal, or boulder, harvest +5 Phosphorus.
flavor: Cords sheathe a rock face and draw down its dissolved phosphate charge.
notes: The basic P HARVEST card the family direction explicitly asks for (parity with the basic W harvest). Free deck-floor; the canonical +3 harvest from CONFIG.resources.harvestPhosphorus. Global contact check (R7, no node/strand targeting). Unplayable when not in contact with a P feature (R6-style: no do-nothing fallback) -> rewards routing to rock first. Rhizomorph Drill upgrades this to +5.

name: Condense
effect: Gain 5 Water.
flavor: Hydrophobic hyphal mats wick dew straight out of the night air.
notes: Free +1 W producer basic, the Water parallel to Mineralize (free +1 P) for W/P/N basic-floor parity. One-shot, not an engine (repay 0). Critical because Water is the scarce one-lake resource; this keeps W-gated cards from being dead on low-lake routing without breaking the harvest economy (only +1, vs +3 lake tap).

name: Rhizomorph Trunkline
effect: Gain +2 energy every round.
flavor: A melanised rhizomorph - a bundled cable of hyphae that pumps water and nutrients in bulk across long underground runs.
notes: The single biggest per-round energy engine allowed (+4 = the per-engine cap). Pure energy engine: NO W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Flat buy 14, repay 14/4~=3 rounds (uncommon band). CEILING: +4 alone, or +4 (Trunkline) +4-warm (Brown-Rot Mat) handled by the runtime clamp at skip-1=11 -> idle always net-negative. The clamp, not buy cost, is the lever (R12). Distinct from Brown-Rot Mat post-fix: flat +4 forever (steady long-haul anchor) vs Mat's +4-for-3-then-+2 early burst -> Mat better early, Trunkline better as a sustained mid/late cord.

name: Osmotic Cashout
effect: Gain +22 energy.
flavor: Accumulated glycerol and polyols, drawn in with water, are catabolised in a sudden pulse of metabolic energy.
notes: REVIEWER FIX (medium/dominance): raised from +18 to +22 so the 1-Water gate buys a meaningful premium over the ungated burst counterpart (Hyphal Investment, +18 total spread over 3 rounds, no gate). Clean dominance split now: Cashout = INSTANT, all-at-once, ANY timing, can rescue a one-round liquidity crisis, but spends a scarce Water + competes with growth/dig cards for it (sequencing tension); Hyphal Investment = FREE but slow drip, EARLY only, cannot bail you out instantly. One-shot event, NOT an engine -> repayRounds 0, no idle interaction (can't tick), exempt from the energy ceiling. Targeting global (resolves on play, no tap). Renamed from Turgor Surge.

name: Aquaporin Channels
effect: Gain +1 Water every 6 rounds.
flavor: Membrane aquaporins gate a passive flux of water into the growing front until the channels foul and clog.
notes: GLOBAL resource engine (produces W, exempt from energy SUM ceiling, inv. 3; produce.energy 0 so no double-tax flag inv. 4). Lifetime cap 8 makes it strictly EARLY: install LATE and you waste most of the cap before card-dry (real 'too late' read). Repay 4 = flat 14 / ~3.5 resourceValueEquiv, standard band 4-5 (inv. 5). Capped output removes 'prints forever' dominance over the uncapped uncommon below.

name: Phosphatase Reserve
effect: Gain +2 Phosphorus every 8 rounds.
flavor: Secreted acid phosphatases cleave bound phosphate from soil minerals until the readily-accessible reserve is exhausted.
notes: Floor P engine with a HARD LIFETIME CAP of 8 P to kill the auto-include profile (R5 flat cap, no %). Flat buy 14; +1 P/round (~3.5 ev) -> repays in the common/early band only if installed early enough to drain the full 8-P reserve. Bought late, it yields only ~4-5 P before the goal -> 'too late to repay', restoring the early-or-trap read. Pure resource engine -> energy-ceiling EXEMPT (no produce.energy), no W/P/N gate (no double-tax). Global production, no targeting (R7).

name: Mineralizing Saprobe
effect: Gain +1 Phosphorus every 5 rounds.
flavor: Saprobes break down dead matter, mineralising it into phosphate — the colony's steady phosphorus baseline.
notes: The unconditional common +1 N/round producer so N-gated cards are never dead on worm-light levels. GLOBAL (whole network), no targeting tap. Resource engine = exempt from energy ceiling, produces NO energy. +1 N ~3.5 ev -> repay 4 (standard band). The reliable N spine; the ONLY pure-unconditional N engine in the family (Ammonifying Worm Bloom is worm-conditional, Nematophagous Mat has a worm-defense rider) so no duplicate non-decision at a pile. Not flashy, never auto-include because it competes with the conditional traps for the same N role.

name: Sinker Rhizomorph
effect: Once per 10 rounds: Pay 2 P to grow through an in-range rock.
produces: grow through 1 in-range rock per use (every 10 rounds, 2 P)
flavor: A dominant downward cord - the fungal analogue of a tap-root - probes deep to undermine and crack obstacles.
notes: R2 buy 14, repay 4 (uncommon band 4-5). R6: TIER-3 dig ENGINE, clears=[formation,column], whole-rock per round. UNPLAYABLE with no eligible rock in range. 2 PHOSPHORUS gate (tier-3 P-ladder). GROWTH/routing engine, no produce.energy => EXEMPT from energy ceiling. clears formation,column. targeting directional.

name: Constricting Ring
effect: Once per 6 rounds: tap a point where no nematode is within range; the first to enter is digested for +2 P.
flavor: A three-celled ring inflates in a tenth of a second via turgor, throttling the passing nematode (Drechslerella brochopaga).
notes: R7: RADIUS-around-a-tap (small radius 40). Free deck-floor basic (buyCostEnergy 0). +2 N matches eat-a-worm yield. ACTIVE constriction trap (distinct from adhesive-glue lineage). Dud on a clean map, strong where worms roam = placement-dependent, never auto-include. Extenders can flood worm-heavy decks with these.

name: Rehydration Pulse
effect: Pay 3 Water: tap a point; heal all mold damage in a wide area.
flavor: A flush of water re-pressurizes collapsed hyphae, reviving rotted and worm-bitten strands.
notes: RADIUS-around-a-tap, not per-strand (R7/R9). Uses the canonical Amputate radius 60 (small heal); declares radius 60. Cheap reactive water sink (1 W). Defense vs mould/worm. Dead on a clean board, never an auto-include (inv. 7). ANY timing, pays immediately, event repay 0. Threat 'all' (repairs any-source damage). Bottom of the radius-heal family (Rehydration 60 -> Monsoon 160), differentiated by RADIUS SIZE only.

name: Metabolic Reroute
effect: Once per round: choose Water or Phosphorus — spend 2 of the other to gain 1 of the other.
flavor: The colony reroutes its metabolism, trading one assimilated nutrient pool for another it needs more.
notes: The generic W<->P<->N converter at a loss (2->1) so a card gated on a map-absent resource is never fully dead. GLOBAL on stockpiles, no targeting. Lives in the nitrogen family as its N-routing utility. Action cooldown 1, repay 0. 2->1 loss keeps hoarding weak (soft cap 6 still bites) so it's a relief valve, not an engine. Situational = not auto-include.

name: Rhizomorph Lance
effect: Grow up to 6 steps: choose a direction.
flavor: A rhizomorph — a rope of bundled hyphae — shoots ahead as a pre-built transport cord.
notes: Pure distance tempo, now 2 E + 2 W (was 1 E + 2 W) — nudged up so it no longer dominates the paid grow family (Turgor Thrust / Vesicle Surge / Guerrilla Runners / Translocation Cord). Directional growth (R3b/R8): player aims the vector, NOT toward-the-goal pathing. reachSegments 18 (6 steps). Great mid to close on a far pile; weak early, risky late if it overshoots. The single mobility extend (the goal-finisher extend is Fruiting Vigil, distinct payoff). repayRounds 0.

name: Fruiting Vigil
effect: Grow up to 8 steps: choose a direction.
flavor: The colony pours everything into a single primordium, racing to fruit before the soil runs dry.
notes: The premier endgame swing: closes a near-final gap and skips the surface-and-fruit steps. Heavy mixed W 2 + N 2 gate forces resource sequencing; dead weight any time you are not within ~8 cells of the goal (no auto-include). Directional extend the player aims at the goal zone (R8: player-aimed, the one finisher case, not obstacle-pathing). growthAmount 8. flat-14 buy. targeting directional. repayRounds 0.

name: Leading Cord
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 1 W to grow 3 steps in a chosen direction.
flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Installed directional grow ACTION (the repeatable twin of Apical Drive); shares config cards.directionalSteps, now 9 = 3 steps (buffed 2->3 to match Apical Drive). Install 9 E + 3 P, per-use 1 W, every 6.

name: Forager Bloom
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 1 W to grow 3 steps, fanning out in a chosen direction.
flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

name: Questing Front
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 2 W to grow 5 steps toward the nearest food, even out of range.
flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

name: Humus Cache
effect: Shuffle 5 copies of Humus Bed into your draw deck.
flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

name: Crust Reserve
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 2 P to harden a patch, clearing mold and making it immune to infection for 10 rounds.
flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

name: Capillary Runners
effect: Gain +3 Water every 6 rounds.
flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

name: Prospecting Cords
effect: Gain +1 Phosphorus every 8 rounds.
flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

name: Dew Traps
effect: Gain +2 Water every 6 rounds.
flavor: The colony commits cords toward a repeated task, pre-loading the draw deck.
notes: Draw-engine: adds NEW basics to the draw deck (extends the depletion clock), then goes to the graveyard (not recycled). One per non-starting basic — this is how every basic beyond the two starters enters your deck.

name: Colonizing Front
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 1 W to grow 2 steps toward all food in range.
flavor: The colony recommits to its most basic work, refilling the draw deck with fresh runners.
notes: Installed food-seek grow ACTION (the repeatable twin of Hyphal Extension); runs config cards.foodSeekSteps (now 2) food-seek passes per use (buffed 1->2 to match Hyphal Extension). Install 7 E + 1 P, per-use 1 W, every 6.

name: Leaf Fall
effect: Shuffle 5 copies of Leaf Litter Cache into your draw deck.
flavor: The colony recommits to its most basic work, refilling the draw deck with fresh runners.
notes: Draw-engine for a STARTING basic: lets you replenish Leaf Litter Cache (you begin with 5) so the core loop keeps flowing as the deck depletes. Adds NEW basics then graveyards (not recycled).

name: Acorn Fall
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 1 W to bury a small nut cache at the sensing edge.
flavor: A fresh mast fall: the colony recommits to caching nuts, refilling the draw deck with fresh runners.
notes: Draw-engine for a STARTING basic: replenishes Acorn Cache (you begin with 5) so the core loop keeps flowing as the deck depletes. Adds NEW basics then graveyards (not recycled). REPLACES Leaf Fall.

name: Sclerotial Seal
effect: Once per 10 rounds: Pay 1 P to seal any food pile from ants; they reroute to other food.
flavor: The colony crusts the cache in a hard sclerotial rind; the raiding column mills at the seal and carries nothing home.
notes: REPLACES Fungus-Garden Mat (removed: ants only steal from FOOD PILES, so 'turning back ants touching the network' did nothing). Protects the thing ants actually attack — locks a chosen pile for 3 rounds so the column steals 0 leaves from it. ACTION type, so per the directive it costs P (ATP) to activate: playCostPhosphorus 1 each use. CADENCE FIX (adversarial): cooldown raised from 2 to 3 so protection window (3) and cooldown (3) match and coverage cannot fully overlap — it mitigates single-pile ant maps rather than permanently sealing one pile for a trivial 1 P; forces rotation/tradeoff when multiple piles are threatened. Buy 10 (below the old 16 engine — the P gate + cadence is the second cost per BUY-COST REBALANCE). Produces no resource -> energy-ceiling exempt, produces "". RADIUS-free single-pile tap (R7-safe: target a pile, not 'N nearest strands'). Situational: dead on ant-free maps and needs a threatened pile worth sealing, so never auto-include; strong on ant-heavy food-economy maps. Distinct from Picket Hyphae (flat pile-theft reduction) and Aphid Ranch (ant->energy).

name: Melanized Wall
effect: Once per 8 rounds: Pay 3 P to tap a point to clear all infection and protect from reinfection for 10 rounds.
flavor: Corky suberin laid down through every cell wall seals the whole colony against Trichoderma's enzymes at once.
notes: Radius cure-on-tap (round-5 fix: it must not pick specific strands). Tap a point; cures mould infection within radius 80 and blocks reinfection there 2 rounds. ACTION -> costs 1 P per use (P gates repeatable actions). Distinct from Sclerotial Crust (basic pre-emptive protect) and Rehydration Pulse (heals worm/mould DAMAGE, not infection).

name: Quickened Reflex
effect: Permanently speed up one installed "use" card: it becomes ready 1 round faster. Max 1 per card.
flavor: Signals race the cords; the colony reacts before the world settles.
notes: Tempo upgrade — permanently shortens the every-N-rounds wait on installed abilities (min 1); applies to abilities already installed and any installed later.

name: Impulse Relay
effect: Permanently speed up one installed "use" card: it becomes ready 2 rounds faster. Max 1 per card.
flavor: Each hypha relays the impulse onward, halving the pause between strikes.
notes: Tempo upgrade — permanently shortens the every-N-rounds wait on installed abilities (min 1); applies to abilities already installed and any installed later.

name: Hair-Trigger Hyphae
effect: Permanently speed up one installed "use" card: it becomes ready 3 rounds faster. Max 1 per card.
flavor: The mat is primed to fire at the faintest cue — barely a breath between uses.
notes: Tempo upgrade — permanently shortens the every-N-rounds wait on installed abilities (min 1); applies to abilities already installed and any installed later.

name: Brisk Metabolism
effect: Permanently speed up one installed resource generation card: it becomes ready 1 round faster. Max 1 per card.
flavor: Enzymes turn over a little faster; the harvest comes round quicker.
notes: Tempo upgrade — permanently shortens the every-N-rounds wait on installed abilities (min 1); applies to abilities already installed and any installed later.

name: Enzyme Overclock
effect: Permanently speed up one installed resource generation card: it becomes ready 2 rounds faster. Max 1 per card.
flavor: Catalysis driven hard — the producers cycle well ahead of schedule.
notes: Tempo upgrade — permanently shortens the every-N-rounds wait on installed abilities (min 1); applies to abilities already installed and any installed later.

name: Metabolic Surge
effect: Permanently speed up one installed resource generation card: it becomes ready 3 rounds faster. Max 1 per card.
flavor: The whole colony runs hot, dumping resource on a breakneck clock.
notes: Tempo upgrade — permanently shortens the every-N-rounds wait on installed abilities (min 1); applies to abilities already installed and any installed later.

name: Turgor Spark
effect: Gain +13 energy.
flavor: A quick osmotic snap floods the cords with sugar.
notes: One-shot P->energy burst (smallest). ~6.5 energy per P.

name: Vacuolar Burst
effect: Gain +33 energy.
flavor: Swollen vacuoles rupture, dumping their charge at once.
notes: One-shot P->energy burst (medium).

name: Glycogen Crush
effect: Gain +54 energy.
flavor: Stored glycogen is crushed down to raw fuel in a heartbeat.
notes: One-shot P->energy burst (large).

name: Cytoplasmic Cascade
effect: Gain +82 energy.
flavor: The whole cytoplasm cascades into a single surge of power.
notes: One-shot P->energy burst (huge).

name: Cord Capillary
effect: Gain +1 energy every round.
flavor: A slender capillary trickles a steady current through the mat.
notes: Small energy engine (+1/round). Cheap.

name: Rhizomorph Dynamo
effect: Gain +3 energy every round.
flavor: A thick cord winds like a dynamo, pumping charge with every pulse.
notes: Large energy engine (+3/round). Total energy-engine income is clamped by cc.engineEnergyClamp.

name: Amputate
effect: Tap a point: remove all mycelium within a radius — cut off infection.
flavor: Sever the doomed tissue before the rot spreads through it.
notes: Basic targeted anti-Trichoderma tool: removes every node within cards.amputateRadius. Refuses to wipe the whole colony. Seeded in the draw deck (basic).

name: Severing Cords
effect: Once per 8 rounds: Pay 2P to tap to remove all mycelium within a radius.
flavor: A reflex arc primed to autotomise infected tissue on command.
notes: Installed ACTION version of Amputate (every 5 rounds, free per use, targeted).

name: Sclerotial Rind
effect: Once per 6 rounds: Pay 1 P to harden strands in a radius — immune to infection and eating for 10 rounds.
flavor: A living rind of hardened tissue, renewed on a cycle.
notes: Installed ACTION version of Sclerotial Crust: cure + permanent mouldProof + hardened (eat-proof) in radius 60. Per-use 1 P (spec cost).

name: Constricting Snap
effect: Tap a point: the nearest nematode within range is digested for +3 P.
flavor: A ring of three cells inflates in a tenth of a second and throttles the worm on the spot — Drechslerella, fired at will.
notes: Event version of Constricting Ring: instant single-worm kill + phosphorus, vs the ring's laid trap. Targeted; radius cards.snapRadius. No-op if no worm in range.

name: Toxocyst Burst
effect: Tap a point: every nematode within a radius is digested (+1 P each, max 10 P).
flavor: Oyster-mushroom hyphae bristle with toxocysts; one touch bursts a droplet that stills the worm within minutes (Pleurotus ostreatus).
notes: Event AoE anti-nematode: removes all worms within cards.toxocystRadius, +1 P each. Distinct from Constricting Ring's single-worm ring. No-op if none in range.

name: Toxocyst Array
effect: Once per 8 rounds: tap a point — every nematode within a radius is digested.
flavor: A standing field of toxocyst glands, recharging its paralytic droplets between kills.
notes: Installed (engine) version of Toxocyst Burst: repeatable AoE worm clear every 8 rounds, free per use, NO phosphorus reward (prevents a worm-farm). Targeted.

name: Cordyceps Bloom
effect: Destroy the nearest ant nest within sensing range.
flavor: Ophiocordyceps threads the nest; days later fruiting stalks erupt from every worker and the raiding column is gone.
notes: Event anti-ant: destroys the nearest nest whose closest colony node is within growth.sensingRadius (attackNest frac 1). Non-targeted (auto). No-op if no nest in range. Proximity-gated; cheaper than 3x Attack Ants.

name: Cordyceps Stroma
effect: Once per 10 rounds: destroy the nearest ant nest within sensing range.
flavor: A perennial graveyard of fruiting stalks; each cycle it seeds a fresh infection into the next nest the colony can reach.
notes: Installed (engine) version of Cordyceps Bloom: destroys a sensed nest every 10 rounds, free per use, non-targeted. Clears finite nests over time.

name: Guerrilla Runners
effect: Grow 5 steps: choose a direction.
flavor: Widely-spaced runner hyphae strike out fast and thin — the guerrilla foraging form, trading density for reach across barren ground.
notes: NEW paid basic grow (owner batch). DIRECTIONAL drag-aim, grow 5 steps (config cards.grow5Segments = 15), straight=false so it reads as exploratory/probing. Cost 1 E (buyCostEnergy) + 1 W + 1 P — the cheap, resource-light long reach that fills the gap between Apical Drive (3) and Rhizomorph Lance (6). familyKey:basics.

name: Turgor Thrust
effect: Grow 4 steps: choose a direction.
flavor: Turgor pressure builds behind the apex and rams the tip forward — pure hydrostatic extension, one committed line.
notes: NEW paid basic grow. DIRECTIONAL drag-aim, grow 4 steps (config cards.grow4Segments = 12), straight=true (a committed thrust). Cost 2 E + 1 W — the WATER-route grow 4 (turgor is driven by water). familyKey:basics.

name: Vesicle Surge
effect: Grow 4 steps: choose a direction.
flavor: The Spitzenkörper floods the apex with secretory vesicles, laying down new wall so fast the tip surges ahead.
notes: NEW paid basic grow. DIRECTIONAL drag-aim, grow 4 steps (config cards.grow4Segments = 12), straight=true. Cost 3 E + 1 P — the PHOSPHORUS-route grow 4 (vesicle traffic / ATP), so a grow-4 stays playable when Water is dry. familyKey:basics.

name: Translocation Cord
effect: Grow 5 steps: choose a direction.
flavor: A differentiated cord translocates cytoplasm and water in bulk down its length, driving one long committed run to the front.
notes: NEW paid basic grow. DIRECTIONAL drag-aim, grow 5 steps (config cards.grow5Segments = 15), straight=true (a committed cord). Cost 2 E + 2 P — the PHOSPHORUS-heavy long reach; twin of Guerrilla Runners on the P axis. familyKey:basics.

name: Explorer Cord
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 1 W to grow 5 steps in a chosen direction.
flavor: A permanent exploratory cord that keeps casting fresh runner hyphae into open ground, cycle after cycle.
notes: NEW grow ENGINE (installed action) — the repeatable twin of Guerrilla Runners. Grow 5 steps (grow5Segments 15), straight=false. Install 17 E + 3 P, per-use 1 W, every 6. W-route install ladder is a consistent +4 E/step (Leading Cord g3 9E -> Turgor Line g4 13E -> Explorer Cord g5 17E) so each rung keeps a real niche (fixes the earlier 15E inversion that squeezed Turgor Line). familyKey:installs.

name: Turgor Line
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 1 W to grow 4 steps in a chosen direction.
flavor: A standing pressurised line: every cycle it re-pressurises and drives its tips a little further on turgor alone.
notes: NEW grow ENGINE — the repeatable twin of Turgor Thrust. Grow 4 steps (grow4Segments 12), straight=true. Install 13 E + 3 P, per-use 1 W, every 6. WATER-per-use route. familyKey:installs.

name: Vesicle Supply Line
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 1 P to grow 4 steps in a chosen direction.
flavor: A dedicated supply line ferries wall-building vesicles to the front on a cycle, feeding the tips forward — paid in phosphate.
notes: NEW grow ENGINE — the repeatable twin of Vesicle Surge. Grow 4 steps (grow4Segments 12), straight=true. Install 10 E + 3 P, per-use 1 P, every 6. PHOSPHORUS-per-use route — non-dominated vs Turgor Line: cheaper E install, but each use spends scarce P. familyKey:installs.

name: Bulk-Flow Cord
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 1 P to grow 5 steps in a chosen direction.
flavor: A heavy transport cord moves fluid in bulk on a cycle, pushing a long run whenever the phosphate is there to fund it.
notes: NEW grow ENGINE — the repeatable twin of Translocation Cord. Grow 5 steps (grow5Segments 15), straight=true. Install 14 E + 4 P, per-use 1 P, every 6. PHOSPHORUS-per-use route (twin of Explorer Cord on the P axis). familyKey:installs.

name: Rhizomorph Cable
effect: Once per 6 rounds: pay 2 W to grow 6 steps in a chosen direction.
flavor: The colony maintains a true rhizomorph cable — a bundled rope of hyphae — and fires it forward on a cycle to lance across open ground.
notes: NEW grow ENGINE — the installed twin of Rhizomorph Lance. Grow 6 steps (reachSegments 18), straight=true. Install 20 E + 4 P, per-use 2 W, every 6 — the top of the grow-engine ladder (above Explorer g5 17E; +1 reach step AND double per-use water, so it isn't a trivial +1E upgrade). familyKey:installs.

name: Decoy Cache
effect: Drop a 1⚡ food cache anywhere in sight.
flavor: A knot of sugar-rich hyphae, left deliberately exposed — bait for the hungry things in the dark.
notes: Tactical EVENT (lure). targeted() point-placement gated by colony LINE OF SIGHT (clear line from any strand, no distance cap) — see EFFECTS['Decoy Cache'] -> dropDecoyCache(). Drops a nut cache worth exactly 1 energy; redirects ant harvest + draws nematodes. Cost: 2 Energy + 1 Water. category 'substrate' + familyKey 'defense' -> shows under the Substrate + Defense filters (plus Event).

name: Perennial Decoy
effect: Once per 8 rounds: pay 1 W to drop a 1⚡ leaf-litter cache anywhere in sight.
flavor: A standing bait station the colony keeps restocking — a fresh lure whenever the hungry things wander close.
notes: ENGINE twin of Decoy Cache: an installed ACTION (Actions menu). Install 10 Energy + 1 Phosphorus; each use pays 1 Water and drops a 1-energy YELLOW LEAF-LITTER cache (foodKind 'duff') anywhere in colony LINE OF SIGHT (dropDecoyCache(s,ctx,'duff'), losHint on a blocked tap). every:8 cooldown. Art REUSES the archived Leaf Litter Cache face (assets/cards/perennial-decoy.jpg = copy of leaf-litter-cache.jpg). category 'substrate' + familyKey 'defense' -> Engine + Substrate + Defense filters.
